polaris.question: Hi Lumi, it's the start of November 2026.  This month's big sale is the 11.11 mega sale. What are the 3 most important things I should do this month to make more profit? Please be specific, with numbers.
polaris.advice:
With only six weeks until year-end and major shopping days like 11.11 (Nov 11) and Deepavali (Nov 8) ahead, focus on clearing slow stock, boosting high-margin channels, and tightening cash flow to hit MYR 8,800 monthly profit.

1. **Run a flash bundle on slow sellers**: Discount the pleated midi skirt (cost MYR 32) to MYR 55 (still above cost) and bundle it with a silk-touch scarf (cost MYR 12) for MYR 80. Sell via Instagram/WhatsApp (0% fee) and pop-ups—target 30 bundles this month to free ~MYR 1,472 tied stock and generate ~MYR 1,440 profit (vs. near-zero if unsold).  
2. **Shift 40% of Shopee/TikTok sales to website**: For the satin wrap dress (MYR 139), website profit is MYR 82 (59%) vs. Shopee MYR 68 (49%). Move ~13 of the 32 expected dress sales to your site (via Instagram bio link or QR at pop-ups) to gain ~+MYR 182 extra profit this month.  
3. **Prepay October’s supplier invoice early**: Pay MYR 5,594 stock cost by Nov 5 to avoid cash crunch during 11.11 ad spend. With MYR 15k bank and MYR 877 net profit last month, this keeps you liquid for MYR 3,300 marketing push and MYR 1,200 rent, preventing missed sales from stockouts.  

Track daily sales by channel in a simple sheet—aim for MYR 7,300+ sales by Nov 30 to cover costs and hit profit goal. Let me know if you’d like a bookkeeping setup walkthrough next! ✨

polaris.question: Hi Lumi, it's the start of December 2026. Last month: 2026-11: sales MYR 14k from 133 orders (108 new, 25 repeat), average order MYR 104. About 25 orders lost to stock-outs or packing limits. Ran out of: Satin wrap dress (12 more wanted), Linen co-ord set (9 more wanted), Tailored blazer (9 more wanted). Stock left: 58 pieces worth MYR 1,656 at cost (bought 84). Ads MYR 2,400, about MYR 74 per order from ads. Platform fees MYR 1,119. Costs MYR 12k, net MYR 2,122. Cash now MYR 17k. Shop rating 4.52. This month's big sale is the 12.12 year-end sale. What are the 3 most important things I should do this month to make more profit? Please be specific, with numbers.
polaris.advice:
Last month’s strong demand shows you’re leaving profit on the table due to stock‑outs—especially dresses, sets, and blazers—and ad spend isn’t translating efficiently into margin because too many sales happen on high‑fee platforms.

Here are three focused actions to lift profit this month:

1. **Re‑stock top sellers before 12.12** – Order 30 satin wrap dresses, 20 linen co‑ord sets, and 15 tailored blazers from your KL tailor today (cost ~MYR 3,150). Aim to have them ready by 8 Dec so you capture the estimated 30 extra orders (based on last month’s unmet demand) at an average MYR 104 order value, adding ~MYR 3,120 revenue and ~MYR 1,560 profit after average platform fees.

2. **Shift 40% of December sales to your website** – For every order placed via Instagram/WhatsApp or TikTok Live, include a printed card offering MYR 10 off the same item on your site (code WEBSAVE10). Target converting ~50 of your projected 150 December orders to the website, saving ~MYR 630 in platform fees (average 9–14%) while keeping the same MYR 104 AOV.

3. **Trim ad waste by pausing low‑ROAS creatives** – Review your MYR 2,400 November ad spend: identify which ads drove <2 orders/MYR 1,000 spend and pause them immediately. Reallocate that saved budget (~MYR 600) to boost posts featuring the silk‑touch scarf (highest margin) and retarget website visitors with the WEBSAVE10 offer, aiming to lower cost per order from MYR 74 to ~MYR 50 and protect net profit.

Target the 20 highest‑margin items (e.g., silk‑touch scarves, pleated midi skirt) and add a MYR 5 “website‑only” bundle discount. Moving just 20 IG/WhatsApp orders (≈ MYR 2,060 sales) to the site saves ~MYR 41 in fees and captures emails for future repeat‑buy campaigns.

Track via a unique TikTok Shop coupon to measure uptake.  

These three moves attack the stock‑out loss, improve channel mix, and liquidate idle inventory—each directly lifts December’s –MYR 3,418 toward profitability this month. Let me know if you’d like the exact reorder quantities or ad‑spend tweaks. ✨📘

polaris.question: Hi Lumi, it's the start of March 2027. Last month: 2027-02: sales MYR 9,509 from 85 orders (60 new, 26 repeat), average order MYR 112. About 67 orders lost to stock-outs or packing limits. Ran out of: Satin wrap dress (45 more wanted), Linen co-ord set (12 more wanted), Tailored blazer (20 more wanted). Stock left: 43 pieces worth MYR 1,256 at cost (bought 95). Ads MYR 1,680, about MYR 109 per order from ads. Platform fees MYR 709. Costs MYR 9,508, net MYR 1. Cash now MYR 11k. Shop rating 4.4. This month's big sale is the Raya last-call sale. What are the 3 most important things I should do this month to make more profit? Please be specific, with numbers.
polaris.advice:
With frequent stock‑outs cutting potential sales and thin margins on some channels, tightening inventory control and shifting volume to higher‑profit sales will boost profit fast.

1. Reorder top sellers based on lost demand: add 45 satin wrap dresses, 12 linen co‑ord sets, and 20 tailored blazers to your next supplier run (cost ≈ MYR (45×52)+(12×66)+(20×92)= MYR 5,094). This could recover ~ MYR (45×77)+(12×90)+(20×111) ≈ MYR 6,285 in missed profit.  
2. Push at least 30 % of February’s 85 orders (~ 25 orders) to your own website or Instagram/WhatsApp (0 % fee) instead of Shopee/TikTok—use a “Free gift with website order” promo (e.g., a silk‑touch scarf costing MYR 12) to shift volume and save ~ MYR (25 orders × avg fee MYR 8.35) ≈ MYR 209 in platform fees this month.  
3. Run a pre‑order flash bundle for the slow‑selling pleated midi skirt: offer it with a matching scarf at a bundled price of MYR 110 (cost ≈ MYR 44) and promote via TikTok Live (target 80+ viewers) and influencer code NURA10. Aim for 15 bundles sold → profit ≈ MYR (15×(110−44)) = MYR 990 and clears aged stock.  

Track daily stock levels and website order share; adjust reorder quantities weekly. Good luck!

polaris.question: Hi Lumi, it's the start of April 2027. Last month: 2027-03: sales MYR 12k from 110 orders (74 new, 36 repeat), average order MYR 112. This month's big sale is the Post-Raya clearance. What are the 3 most important things I should do this month to make more profit? Please be specific, with numbers.
polaris.advice:
Last month’s tight margin came from high ad spend relative to return and frequent stock‑outs on top‑selling items—each lost order means ~MYR 112 revenue gone plus the ad cost spent to acquire it. Fixing inventory flow and sharpening ad efficiency will lift profit without raising prices.

1. Re‑order fast‑sellers based on last month’s demand: add 25 Satin wrap dresses, 15 Linen co‑ord sets, and 20 Tailored blazers (cost ≈ MYR 5,250) to cover the 36+ lost orders and build a 2‑week buffer.  
2. Cut ad waste: pause the lowest‑performing 20 % of TikTok/Shopee campaigns (save ~MYR 336) and reinvest half into boosting the website channel (lower 2.9 % fee) via retargeting ads to the 36 repeat buyers from March.  
3. Launch a “Post‑Raya clearance” bundle on 9 May (Mother’s Day) pairing the slow‑selling Pleated midi skirt with a best‑selling Silk‑touch scarf at MYR 119 (skirt MYR 89 + scarf MYR 39), moving ~30 skirts and clearing MYR 1,088 tied‑up stock while earning ~MYR 420 extra profit.
